item.title: 2026-11-27: Chinese and North Korean state hackers now run ARTEX, an open-source multi-agent pentest framework, against web apps and APIs
item.description:
• Chinese and North Korean state hackers now run ARTEX, an open-source multi-agent pentest framework, against web apps and APIs
  • Google will require AI agents to reach Workspace through its MCP servers from 1 February, and the public Gmail server cannot send
  • Inconsistent docs make coding agents spend 38% more tokens, even when they get the task right
  • "Zero data retention" DeepSeek routes on OpenRouter traced to ByteDance's Ark API
  • GitHub will bill Copilot code review to the organization by default from 30 December
  • Training agents to work as a team beat best-of-8 retries at an eighth of the tokens
  • NVIDIA open-sources Nemotron 3.5 Parse, a 0.6B document parser with training data and a 7.6× speculative decoder
